ns2:section.sectionText: This is the discussion/recitation section that meets online. Webcasts, course materials, and a discussion board will be made available online through Illinois Compass. Students are expected to take course exams and complete online assignments on ACE Organic as outlined in the syllabus. Students must report to campus or to an approved off-site testing center for all exams. Discussion sessions will be conducted online using Elluminate Live! at the indicated times. You are expected to either participate in the live discussion session or watch the completed archived session online.
